name: tableau
description: Tableau integration via the Tableau REST API (v3.23) — list workbooks, views, data sources, and background jobs, pull view data as structured rows, search content by name, and trigger full extract refreshes. Authenticates with a Personal Access Token (PAT): the PAT name and secret are exchanged at /auth/signin for a short-lived session token per invocation. Works with Tableau Cloud and Tableau Server 2024.2 or later.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Tableau Cloud / Server content and data via the REST API (PAT auth)

fields.label: Tableau URL
fields.helpText: Your Tableau Cloud pod URL (e.g. https://10ax.online.tableau.com) or your Tableau Server URL.

fields.label: Site Content URL
fields.helpText: The site name as it appears in your Tableau URLs (the value after /site/). Leave empty for the default site on Tableau Server; required on Tableau Cloud.

fields.label: Personal Access Token Name
fields.helpText: The name you gave the Personal Access Token in My Account Settings > Personal Access Tokens.

fields.label: Personal Access Token Secret
fields.helpText: The token secret shown once when the PAT was created.

tools.name: tableau.list_workbooks
tools.description: List workbooks on the site with project, owner, last-update time, and web URL.

tools.name: tableau.list_views
tools.description: List views on the site, or the views of one workbook when workbookId is given.

workbookId.description: Workbook id (LUID) to list views for; omit to list all views on the site

tools.name: tableau.list_datasources
tools.description: List published data sources on the site with type, project, and last-update time.

limit.description: Max data sources to return (default 25, max 100)

tools.name: tableau.get_view_data
tools.description: Get the underlying data of a view as structured rows (columns, rows, count). Rows beyond the cap are dropped and flagged with truncated=true.

viewId.description: View id (LUID) to fetch data for

tools.name: tableau.search_content
tools.description: Search workbooks, views, and data sources whose name contains the query (case-insensitive), merged into one result. Matches client-side over the first 100 items of each content type.

query.description: Text to match against content names (case-insensitive substring)

limit.description: Max results per content type (default 25, max 100)

tools.name: tableau.list_jobs
tools.description: List background jobs (extract refreshes, subscriptions) with type, status, and creation time — useful for refresh-failure triage.

tools.name: tableau.refresh_datasource
tools.description: Trigger an extract refresh for a published data source. This is always a FULL refresh (not incremental) and queues a background job on the server.
